mission: Post-teaching — the asteroid offer named; Jacen's interior consolidation toward acceptance.
why_now: The teaching has crystallized the next step.
opening_hook: Jacen walking back to his apartment in the Coruscant underlevels after the teaching session.
conflict: Jacen's interior argument against accepting the offer vs. his growing certainty that he must.
turning_point: Jacen decides, silently, that he will accept the asteroid trip.
closing_hook: Jacen at his apartment door, keycode in hand, already-decided.
setting: Coruscant underlevel walkway and apartment approach.
sensory_details: Underlevel neon; damp corridor smell; Jacen's quieter breathing.
emotional_trajectory: Post-teaching restlessness → interior consolidation → settled commitment.
notes: The book's interior-turn scene; decision made but not yet enacted.
